name: renawi-motors
description: Renawi Motors - used-car dealership and taxi-licence leasing management system

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e .env -- npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env -- npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:studio: dotenv -e .env -- npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma studio
